title: girl-agent: Personality-First Telegram AI Persona Engine
summary: girl-agent is an open-source framework designed to simulate realistic AI personalities in Telegram, featuring human-like schedules and evolving relationship dynamics. It eliminates standard AI assistant tropes in favor of autonomous character behavior, including sleep patterns and emotional mood states.
research_notes: Includes support for both MTProto userbots and standard Telegram Bot API.

evolution.summary: The project introduced Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration, Docker support, and a streamlined CLI installation process. Recent updates focus on complex emotional modeling through specific counters for trust, attraction, and irritation.
